reply.en: Done. I ran the shop queries again, so the last two weeks of April are in. Launch week shows: 1,943 active subscribers (195 more than on April 13), MRR at $120.3k, and you are now 56 ahead of the goal path. First Light is already the second most shipped roast.
reply.zh: 好了。我重新跑了一遍店铺的查询，4 月最后两周的订单已经进来。上新那一周很明显：活跃订阅 1,943 人（比 4 月 13 日那周多 195 人），MRR 到了 $120.3k，现在比目标线高出 56 人。First Light 已经是出货量第二的豆子。

args.query:
SELECT s.week, s.plan, s.active, s.new, s.churned, s.mrr, o.orders, o.revenue
FROM subscription_weeks s
JOIN (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', placed_at)::date AS week, plan,
         count(*) AS orders, sum(total) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) o USING (week, plan)
WHERE s.week >= DATE '2026-02-02'
ORDER BY s.week, s.plan

SELECT date_trunc('week', o.placed_at)::date AS week, o.plan, i.roast, sum(i.bags) AS bags
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.placed_at >= DATE '2026-02-02'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT order_no, placed_at, plan, roast, bags, total, status
FROM orders
ORDER BY placed_at DESC
LIMIT 8
